sections.text: Cracks are spreading through the glass city. Beneath the market, an old service tunnel may lead to the foundation controls.

consequence.text: Broken glass scratches your boots and ankles.

sections.text: The glassworker binds your cuts and explains the city's oldest repair technique. A public terrace offers a safe place to wait.

options.description: Take the bandages and enter the tunnel
Help people gather on the terrace

sections.text: A fallen support blocks the route to the control vault. The market stair remains open behind you.

consequence.text: A sharp edge opens a deep cut.

sections.text: Two controls remain intact. One stabilizes the supports slowly; the other releases pressure through a damaged emergency hatch.

consequence.text: A burst of glass fragments strikes you.

sections.text: From the terrace, you watch the city settle. Neighbors begin replacing the damaged panes together.
Pressure escapes into the dawn air. Sunlight reaches the foundation for the first time in a century.
